title: Dojo Duel
description: A 1v1 fighting game inspired by Tekken: four fighters with their own styles and specials, punch and kick strings, launchers and juggles, throws, high/low blocking and best-of-three rounds. Beat four CPU fighters in Arcade for the leaderboard, play a friend on the same keyboard or with gamepads, or fight anyone online with Quick Match or a room code.
